lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\MusicSheetViewer\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
6 uses of the private API of the server in 4 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

places: lib/Controller/DisplayController.php:53 OCP\AppFramework\Http\EmptyContentSecurityPolicy::allowEvalScript(): Nextcloud 33 is the last major to have it, the app declares up to 34; Eval should not be used anymore. Please update your scripts. This function will stop functioning in a future version of Nextcloud.
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that a major of Nextcloud 32 to 34 no longer has. The app fails there where it comes to that line, or the server no longer calls the method it overrides.
